svg.font-family: Calibri, Carlito, 'Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: How a run is measured
svg.desc: Benchmark tasks run headless in one of four modes. Every run leaves a cassette, a span tree and the deck; deterministic checks and judged grades score it, and the results store draws the quality and cost frontier per category and per configuration.
svg.text: a Claude Code session answers each request:
the frontier reference, no API bill
recorded answers, a miss fails loudly:
real providers, answers kept as cassettes
real providers, per-role models; a spend
ledger stops a run at its budget
span tree: why each step ran,
the deck and its page images
the task's checklist, item by item;
the judge must agree with people
Results store: quality against cost and runtime, per category and per model configuration; the frontier the project exists to move
